messages:
Claire (Product): Heads-up: we're opening a limited preview of the new Sapphire micro-pools (A40S-Lite) in Monterrey and Johannesburg tomorrow at 1800 UTC. These are 1- and 2-GPU micro-pools meant for latency-sensitive, low-concurrency workloads.
Diego (Cloud Ops): Nice — what's the expected burst window and reservation flow?
Claire (Product): Preview burst windows: Monterrey 18:00-22:00 UTC, Johannesburg 00:00-04:00 UTC. Reservation API will support 1h and 4h slots during the preview. This is a soft preview; capacity may fluctuate.
ops-bot: Reservation service version v1.14 deployed. New tag: "sapphire-preview" will be auto-applied to reservations created via CLI/ui.
Ethan (SRE): SLA for preview pools? Any impact on fallback routing to existing pools?
Claire (Product): No SLA for preview. Routing will prefer Sapphire when a request explicitly pins the pool label; otherwise requests may fall back to nearby A40/RTX pools. We'll publish routing rules in the digest doc.
Diego (Cloud Ops): Policy update: fairburst policy in effect for preview — orgs are limited to 4x1h bursts per 24h per region. Also preemptible instances are disabled for Sapphire micro-pools during preview to reduce churn.
Maya (Sales): Can we offer early access to a couple of enterprise beta customers? They asked about Monterrey latency for APAC customers.
Claire (Product): Yes — please open a support case referencing this thread and tag "early-sapphire". We'll grant up to 3 enterprise white-listed orgs per region for the first week.
Diego (Cloud Ops): CLI example for reservations (preview):
```
redwood reserve --pool sapphire-a40s-lite --region mx-1 --duration 1h --label sapphire-preview
```
Note: reservations created with --label sapphire-preview auto-bill to preview ledger.
ops-bot: Reminder: reservations without an explicit project tag will be suspended after 15m for preview safety. Use --project or the Console to set billing tags.
Ethan (SRE): Any monitoring hooks we should add to alerting? CPU/GPU thermal spikes during the first 48h?
Diego (Cloud Ops): Add the new metric series refinery.sapphire.gpu.temp and refinery.sapphire.latency to team dashboards. We'll also emit an event when fallback routing is triggered so SRE can correlate.
Claire (Product): Docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/preview-sapphire-micro-pools (internal). Will follow up with a short runbook for support and a one-pager for sales.
Maya (Sales): Thanks. I'll queue two customers for Monterrey and one for JNB.
Claire (Product): Launch checklist: 1) Ops ramped for first 48h (done) 2) Billing tags verified (ops-bot) 3) Docs up (in flight) 4) Enterprise whitelist process (open). If you want early access, file the support case before 12:00 UTC tomorrow. :rocket:
ops-bot: Audit note: preview-sapphire rollout initiated by Claire. All reservation events will be logged under audit/preview-sapphire.
Ethan (SRE): Copy — will add alerts and keep a rotation for the first 72h.
Diego (Cloud Ops): We'll post postmortem-template links in #incidents if we see instability.
Claire (Product): Thanks all — will post an official announcement to public channels once whitelists are seeded.
